id: title:Gilbert09:keep the queue depth gauge honest during a backlog

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves queue depth gauge reliability and reduces database load during warehouse ingestion, though complete implementation and database-layer changes are not shown.
review.reason: The chunk adds fallback mechanisms and SQL helpers to preserve queue depth gauges and reduce database dependency during warehouse ingestion. P1.F1.H7 and P1.F1.H8 implement fallbacks to prevent NaN exports when freshness or depth probes time out, preserving the last good sample. P1.F5.H1 replaces heavy breakdown SQL with a lightweight index-only count. While the chunk lacks the DB,
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on test assertions and SQL changes; complete implementation and database-layer behavior are not shown, preventing a definitive tier 3 assessment.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the corresponding implementation changes in the database layer or the complete implementation of the gauge export and timeout handling. The test assertions and SQL changes are present, but the production implementation of the fallback behavior and the complete gauge export path are not shown. This prevents a complete assessment of the systemic benefit.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback mechanism to preserve queue depth gauges when a depth probe times out, rather than returning NaN.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves the last good depth sample and its age when the breakdown probe times out, preventing NaN from being exported as an empty queue.

observations.behavior: Adds a fallback mechanism to preserve queue depth gauges when a freshness probe times out, rather than returning NaN.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves the last good depth sample and its age when the freshness probe times out, preventing NaN from being exported as an empty queue.

observations.behavior: Adds a new SQL helper and its documentation, while removing the bulk of the breakdown SQL and its associated fields, and wiring a fallback path.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a lightweight, index-only count of claimable batches that does not depend on the heavier group-level breakdown, allowing the depth probe to complete even when the full breakdown times out.
